actual_checks: Full literal D2 prompt, metadata/API/source/author records, report and full earlier contribution read. The earlier announced infinite-group counterexample is not verified or used. This contribution supplies actual finite-group unstabilized/stabilized ranges and an independently checked algebraic splitting.

For finite G, def(G) convention makes 1-def(G) the minimum Euler characteristic of a finite presentation 2-complex. Theorem A(i) requires strict chi>1-def(G) for an unstabilized finite simple-homotopy 2-model; at equality A(ii) only gives X wedge S2. The report retains that strict/equality boundary.

In the dimension<=3 cellular model, H3 of the cover vanishes, so partial3 is injective with image B isomorphic to free C3. The B-valued cochain partial3 is a top cocycle; H3(X;B)=0 supplies phi:C2->B restricting identity on B. Thus C2=B direct-sum P with P stably free. Algebraic splitting is not asserted to realize a finite 2-complex or geometrically cancel S2.

Geometric cancellation in the source needs a spare sphere at the minimum; the report does not erase it. Theorem B applies to finite subgroups of SO(3), including cyclic, rotational dihedral, A4,S4,A5, with unstabilized D2 property. Binary SU(2) polyhedral groups and arbitrary finite/infinite groups are not silently included.
